content: Shall be able to represent requirements stated in SWS Type: valid Description: To improve requirements traceability a formalized description of a SWS shall contain textual representatives of each requirement contained in the respective SWS document (specification items of SWSs). The statements shall be categorized as one of {Requirement, Specification, Implementation, Constraint} Rationale: This feature enables a automated tracking of changes of requirements, which is the basis for a improved change management and compatibility assessment.
